item.description: - New Bonzai-shi release: Copy API Key and inline Show API Key from 1Password with automatic clipboard expiry. - Existing managed CLI automatically follows app updates without prompts. - CLI doctor groups diagnostics and PATH help. - One-click CLI installation and safe removal. - Fix key access after Touch ID and key checks and prevent stalled installation verification.

- Run cursor opens exact linked folders or allows temporary key selection in per-key Cursor profiles. - App bundles its matching CLI and offers menu installation/upgrades while retaining previous binaries. - Link/relink offers interactive selection and confirmation; listings show names. - Doctor checks local dependency presence and registry without credential/network access. - Status shows exact folder key and warnings; GUI sidebar shows link indicator/count. - Folder links support ordinary directories, optional Git-root protection, and saved links survive Git changes. - Sessions no longer require Node.js; Ctrl-Z returns to the shell and fg resumes with terminal settings restored; a terminal startup failure is fixed.

- Initialize SQLite with explicit setup, import JSON while preserving key identities, or recover from interrupted setup; decommission old consumers first. - GUI and CLI link exact Git repository roots to keys with explicit overrides and visible failures for missing keys. - CLI launches foreground Claude Code with selected keys and temporary session auth; `--link` confirms before saving, and cancellation prevents launch. - GUI refreshes after CLI updates; corrected terminal handoff avoids startup issues and restores the terminal on exit.
- Checks for updates automatically. - Users can choose Check for Updates in the app menu. - Installation always asks for approval.
